name: clicktronix-development-flow
sensitive_surfaces: public APIs, persisted schemas, and cross-service contracts
money, payments, pricing, billing, and entitlements
infrastructure, CI, deployment, and release configuration
security-relevant input handling: injection, SSRF, path traversal, unsafe deserialization, and server-side allowlists

invariants.requirement: Run executes a committed specification and never reconstructs one from chat.
Each specification owns one named task branch and one pull request.
Unattended execution requires auto_ready: yes in the specification.
A run starts or restarts only from a clean task worktree.
Every journal read, append, resume, and artifact guard verifies the stored run-id and current branch.
Every phase after phase 0 resumes the persisted journal before any other action.
Interactive mode stops after phases 0 through 5 and before merge.
Every criterion names its machine check or human verification step and records the result.
The owning agent reads delegated diffs and verifies their scoped gates and acceptance criteria.
A sensitive-surface change receives deep review regardless of diff size.
Only explicit task paths are staged, and the staged diff is inspected before commit.
Delivery follows the declared delivery_order without skipping or reordering gates.
Required hosted checks are green on the exact current pull-request head SHA.
After merge, only task-lifecycle reconciliation is authorized; deploy, publish, and migration remain forbidden.
